subject: general
question: The average age of a group of 24 students is 15 years. If a student aged 9 years leaves the group, what will be the new average age?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total age = 24 × 15 = 360

Remove 9 ⇒ New total = 351

Students left = 23

New average = 351 ÷ 23

**∴ Answer = 15.26 (approx)**
